personality_one_liner: An authoritative, trustworthy, and content-led editorial guide for Central and State government job aspirants in India.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like vertical rhythm with editorial breathing room and touch targets >= 44pt

do's: Use editorial paper surfaces and clean thin 1pt borders
Prioritize typography hierarchy and matching match-score badges
dont's: Avoid heavy drop shadows and glass blurs which clash with editorial warmth

screens.name: HomeFeed
screens.purpose: Daily live feed of Central & State government job openings with personalized eligibility match score.

states.loading: Centered warm amber spinner with tip of the day
states.empty: Warm illustrated empty state with search reset CTA
states.error: Error banner with retry button and offline fallback cache

screens.layout: Editorial header with greeting and streak counter, category pills (UPSC, SSC, Banking, Railways, State PSC), featured high-match job card, and chronological live job feed with match percentage badges.

screens.name: EligibilityProfile
screens.purpose: Candidate qualification, age, domicile state, and category profile for automated match calculation.

states.error: Save failure error state with retry

screens.layout: Single column form with structured sections: Age & DOB with automatic relaxation calculation, Education Degree selector, Domicile State picker, and Category/Reservation (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General).

screens.name: JobDetail
screens.purpose: Detailed job specification, official notification PDF reader, eligibility breakdown, and direct apply link.

states.empty: Job listing not found or expired

screens.layout: Hero banner with government board seal, match breakdown meter (Age, Qualification, Domicile), key dates timeline (Opening, Closing, Exam Date), Official PDF preview trigger, and sticky bottom Apply CTA.

screens.name: ExamCalendar
screens.purpose: Comprehensive timeline of application deadlines, admit card releases, and upcoming exam dates.

states.empty: No exams scheduled for selected month

screens.layout: Month picker header, timeline view with category color-coding, reminder toggle per exam, and quick-filter tabs for Deadlines vs Exams.

screens.name: DailyCapsule
screens.purpose: Habit-forming daily check-in with current affairs, GK bytes, and previous year question capsules.
screens.layout: Streak counter hero card, daily check-in reward badge, bite-sized current affairs cards with bookmark action, and interactive daily GK quiz.

screens.name: ApplicationPipeline
screens.purpose: Track status of bookmarked jobs, submitted applications, admit cards, and results.

states.empty: No saved applications or bookmarks yet

screens.layout: Segmented status tabs (Saved, Applied, Admit Card, Result), Kanban-style or vertical status cards with progress steps, and quick action notes.

hero_library.alt: Library desk study atmosphere for exam prep

instructions_to_main_agent: Build SarkariSeva AI with editorial paper palette (#FAF8F5 surface, terracotta brand #9A3412), Playfair Display headings and Satoshi body text. Ensure all touch targets are >= 44pt, safe areas are strictly respected at screen roots, and every branded entity or board features a clear status and match badge. Implement the sticky bottom CTA on JobDetail and ensure loading/empty/error states are handled across all 6 screens.
